title: res/{site}/{head_id} payload
description: UPSERT payload of res/{site}/{head_id}: the user's answer to one of the figure's import items (import.proto ITEMS AND ANSWERS), naming the item and its rev. Accepted only while that item of the figure is pending with that rev; otherwise answered STALE. Serialized, at most 33,365 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

item.description: The item answered: the figure's figure item, held-edit card, change entry or align-MFC entry (imp/{site}/{item}/{head_id}).

rev.description: The rev of the item answered, as the item states it.

choice.description: keep, take or per_copy for a figure item (keep is "MFC is behind" on a divergence), keep or take for held edits, undo or dismiss for a change entry, dismiss for an align-MFC entry.

copies.description: With per_copy only: the final status of each listed copy. At most 500.

status.description: Its final status; removed is a tombstone.

fields.description: With per_copy only: which side each disputed figure value takes.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
